extracted.intended_audience: biologists and bioinformaticians analyzing large gene lists (microarray/RNA-seq users, researchers wanting functional annotation and pathway analysis)
extracted.subtask_description: Using DAVID to perform functional annotation, identifier conversion, clustering, and pathway visualization for large gene lists from microarray or other high-throughput experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify enriched biological themes
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: Identify enriched biological themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of DAVID's core functionality to help understand the biological meaning behind large gene lists; uses integrated annotations from the DAVID Knowledgebase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discover enriched functional-related gene groups
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: Discover enriched functional-related gene groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detects groups of genes sharing functional annotation terms to highlight coordinated biological signals in a gene list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cluster redundant annotation terms
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: Cluster redundant annotation terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clusters similar/redundant annotation terms to reduce term redundancy and simplify interpretation of enriched annotations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visualize genes on BioCarta & KEGG pathway maps
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: Visualize genes on BioCarta & KEGG pathway maps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maps gene lists onto curated pathway diagrams to aid pathway-level interpretation and to see gene placement within biological pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display many-genes-to-many-terms relationships in 2D
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: Display many-genes-to-many-terms relationships in 2D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides two-dimensional visualizations showing complex relationships between genes and annotation terms to aid discovery of functionally related modules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for functionally related genes not in the list
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: Search for functionally related genes not in the list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables expansion of gene lists by finding additional genes functionally related to the input list, useful for hypothesis generation or network expansion.

rubrics_metrics.name: List interacting proteins
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID tools can: List interacting proteins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides protein interaction information related to input genes to support network and interaction-based interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore gene names in batch (Gene List Report / Gene Name Batch Viewer)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Gene List Report (formally the Gene Name Batch Viewer) tool allows translation of gene lists to corresponding gene names in batch as well as providing links to further gene annotations and related genes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to standardize and expand identifiers; returns links to further annotations and related genes to streamline downstream analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gene Search supports multiple identifier types without full list upload
rubrics_metrics.description: The gene search tool allows a user to search for a gene/protein identifier such as gene symbol, Ensembl, NCBI Gene ID, etc without uploading a full list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handy for quick lookups across supported identifier namespaces; supports gene symbol, Ensembl, NCBI Gene ID and other common IDs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functional Annotation provides tables, charts and clustering
rubrics_metrics.description: The functional annotation tools provide tables, charts and clustering of annotations associated with your gene list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produces tabular and graphical summaries plus clustering to help interpret enriched terms and gene-term associations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gene Functional Classification groups genes by functional similarity
rubrics_metrics.description: The Gene Functional Classification tool groups genes based on functional similarity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Groups genes into functionally related clusters to identify modules or subgroups within the input list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gene ID Conversion between identifier systems
rubrics_metrics.description: The conversion tool converts between different gene/protein identifiers such as gene symbol, Ensembl, NCBI Gene ID, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to harmonize identifiers prior to analysis or to translate results for reporting; supports common identifier mappings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ortholog Tool for cross-species conversion and analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: The DAVID Ortholog tool provides conversion and analysis of gene lists across species.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables comparative or cross-species analyses by converting gene lists to orthologs in other organisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Download & APIs: DAVID Knowledgebase, web services, and API
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID Knowledgebase, web services, and API.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic access and bulk downloads are available for integration into pipelines and reproducible analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation requirement for publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Please cite DAVID within any publication that makes use of any methods inspired by DAVID.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If DAVID methods or inspiration are used in published work, include appropriate citation(s) as indicated on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free usage policy (no login required, commercial allowed)
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID is free to use for all, including commercial users, without login.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No account is required to use DAVID; explicitly allows commercial use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taxonomy-based list upload workflow with multiple file format support
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID now features modernized interfaces across all major analysis tools, including a taxonomy-based list upload workflow with support for multiple file formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newer upload workflows support selection of species/taxonomy and multiple file formats to simplify input handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Species selection support in List Upload Tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Added species selection to List Upload Tool.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows explicit species selection during list upload to ensure correct organism-specific annotation mapping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of adaptive FDR for multiple testing correction
rubrics_metrics.description: FDR changed to adaptive FDR. See documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DAVID uses an adaptive false discovery rate procedure for multiple-testing correction; consult documentation for specifics and implications.
